videos.title: Singapore Airlines Suites Class: Is It Worth 1 Million Miles?
videos.description: We fly Singapore Airlines' legendary Suites Class from Singapore to Tokyo and put the private cabin, the caviar service, and the double bed to the test. Plus a tour of the Singapore Airlines lounge at Changi Airport.

videos.title: 48 Hours in Bangkok: Street Food, Rooftop Bars, and a $30 Hotel Suite
videos.description: A whirlwind 48 hours in Bangkok eating our way through Chinatown street food stalls, watching the sunset from a rooftop bar, and checking into a surprisingly luxe hotel suite for under $30 a night.

videos.title: Ritz-Carlton Kyoto Review: The Best Hotel We've Ever Stayed At?
videos.description: An in-depth review of the Ritz-Carlton Kyoto, including the riverside rooms, the kaiseki breakfast, and whether it's worth booking with points versus cash.

videos.title: Walking Every Street of Lisbon's Alfama District
videos.description: A slow, scenic walking tour through Lisbon's oldest neighborhood, Alfama, with stops for pastel de nata, fado music, and the best miradouro viewpoints.

videos.title: Emirates First Class Shower Spa: 14 Hours from Dubai to Auckland
videos.description: Testing the Emirates A380 First Class shower spa, onboard bar, and private suite on the ultra long-haul route from Dubai to Auckland, booked entirely with miles.

videos.title: Mexico City Food Tour: 12 Tacos in 12 Hours
videos.description: A marathon taco crawl through Mexico City neighborhoods Roma, Condesa, and Centro, tasting tacos al pastor, birria, and everything in between.

shorts.title: The croissant that changed my life (Paris)
shorts.description: This tiny bakery near Le Marais makes the best croissant I've had in Paris, hands down.

shorts.title: This hotel pool in Bali is unreal
shorts.description: An infinity pool overlooking the jungle at a hotel in Ubud, Bali that costs less than a hotel parking fee back home.

shorts.title: How I book business class for less than economy
shorts.description: A quick breakdown of the points and miles trick that got me a business class seat to Tokyo for less than an economy ticket.

shorts.title: Street food stall vs 5-star hotel breakfast
shorts.description: Comparing a $2 street food breakfast in Bangkok to a $80 hotel breakfast buffet. The winner might surprise you.
